Fender Studio Pro X

A free community expansion that gives you your own version of Fender Studio Pro 8, in 10 packages. It installs on your own licensed copy, never touches licensing, and uninstalls in one click.

Vibe-coded by a non-programmer: expect bugs. Back up your songs first.

Get it free: github.com/ferrerokush-png/fender-studio-pro-x

Packages 01 to 05

  • 01Skins. Liquid Glass and Graphite, built on your PC from your own Studio Pro, with a Skins page in Options and live colour changes.Switches: Skins page, Live colours
  • 02Home page. A calm Start page: your sessions, a Quick start card with your templates, music news, your artist card and your audio device.Switches: Session library, News, Spotify panel (off) · adds Skins
  • 03Name and icon. “Fender Studio Pro X” in the title bar and the X app icon.Switches: Hide About and Check for Updates (off)
  • 04Track List. A redesigned Track List with saved views, search and quick show/hide.adds Skins
  • 05Plug-in browser. Instruments and Effects as a modern panel: filters, favourites, folders and search.adds Skins

Packages 06 to 10

  • 06Sound search. Find samples by name, type, key and tempo in Browser > Files; previews play in time with your song, MIDI files too.adds Skins
  • 07YouTube panel. Search YouTube audio in Browser > Cloud, preview it and bring it into your song; optional account tabs (needs yt-dlp and ffmpeg).off at first, adds Skins
  • 08Look extras. Smooth motion, glass pop-up menus, rounded ruler markers and loop.Switches: Smooth motion, Glass pop-ups, Ruler markers and loop
  • 09Pitch curves. Draw and edit per-note pitch curves in the piano roll.
  • 10AI tools. A chat assistant that can drive Studio Pro (any MCP client too), the AI Lab tab, and optional better stems.Switches: Chat assistant & bridge, AI Lab, Better stems (off) · off at first

Core (the mod loader and the web-panel crash guard) is always installed. Version 1.4.0.

New in 1.4.0: YouTube previews work again, with a volume slider and optional account tabs (your sign-in stays on your PC). 1.3.0: Sound search plays with your song. 1.2.x: a cleaner, faster Sound search with MIDI, and a Quick start card. 1.1.0 brought smooth backgrounds, one soft accent light, a stronger Glass tint and Rename on the home page.

Install in 3 steps

Close Studio Pro and unzip the pack.

Double-click Install.bat, tick the packages you want. It adds what they need and shows a summary first.

Skins build from your own copy, then pick one in Options > Skins.

Back to stock

Hold Shift at start for the stock look, run Uninstall.bat for plain Studio Pro, or use a package's own Uninstall.bat to remove just that one.

Licensing untouched. No Fender files shipped. Free, MIT licensed. Windows 10/11, Studio Pro 8 (tested on 8.1.2). Made by Roche with thanks to the Studio One team. Studio One and Studio Pro are trademarks of their owners.
